texts.zh:
赛博勒克斯自肃正协议被击败以来一直较为平静，但据最近发现，一艘大型船只单独离开了赛博勒克斯-贝塔星系。其离开星系后，沿着一条超出我们星系边界的轨道而行。

船只在离开我们的跟踪范围之前，向全星系发送了唯一的一条的信息。
texts.en:
The Cybrex have been relatively quiet since the defeat of the Contingency, but a single massive vessel was recently detected departing Cybrex Beta. It left the system on an outbound trajectory that will take it beyond the limits of our galaxy.

Before the vessel left our tracking range, it transmitted a single galaxy-wide message.
